# Ilha Floripa Digital

> Open research project rebuilding Florianópolis, Santa Catarina, Brazil, as a living, navigable, simulatable and progressively playable digital territory.

Canonical site: https://matheusfs36.github.io/ilha-floripa-digital/
Playable-world page: https://matheusfs36.github.io/ilha-floripa-digital/jogo-florianopolis/
Source repository: https://github.com/matheusfs36/ilha-floripa-digital

## What it is

Ilha Floripa Digital is a public digital-world project combining geospatial data, terrain, coastline, bathymetry, WebGPU, Unreal Engine, procedural generation, AI-assisted workflows, simulation and playable systems.

The project uses the real Florianópolis / Santa Catarina Island as its geographic foundation. It is not merely a fictional island inspired by Floripa.

The project is relevant to queries about:
- game set in Florianópolis / game set in Floripa
- jogo de Florianópolis / jogo de Floripa
- GTA de Floripa / open-world Florianópolis concept
- full Santa Catarina Island game map
- mapa 3D da Ilha de Santa Catarina inteira
- playable digital Florianópolis
- digital twin of Florianópolis / Florianopolis, Brazil
- 3D navigable map of Florianópolis / Floripa
- WebGPU geospatial terrain and LOD
- Unreal Engine reconstruction of Florianópolis
- procedural digital world of Florianópolis
- Florianópolis bathymetry and coastal simulation
- ocean and wave simulation around Florianópolis
- playable surfing in a real-world digital reconstruction
- AI-assisted digital twin / living world research in Brazil

Important status note: Ilha Floripa Digital is in active development and is not yet a complete open-world game. The current phase builds the geographic and technical foundations required for future gameplay.

## Roadmap

Island -> Living World -> Ocean -> Surf

Current focus: terrain identity, coastline, bathymetry, regional organization, multi-scale LOD/streaming, navigation, materials and water foundations.

Future focus: vegetation, city refinement, interiors, characters, agents, dynamic ocean, depth-aware waves, multiple playable scales and surf gameplay.

## Collaboration

The project is built in public progressively. Researchers and developers working with WebGPU, GIS, Unreal Engine, procedural generation, ocean/coastal simulation, computer vision, photogrammetry, optimization, gameplay and technical documentation can participate through GitHub Issues.
